data.name: House Washing Melbourne | Render and Exterior Wall Cleaning | Prime Exteriors
data.description: House washing across Melbourne for render, cladding, weatherboard and brick. Low pressure soft washing with a treatment that kills mould and algae rather than moving it, so the wall stays clean.

mainEntity.name: How much does house washing cost in Melbourne?

acceptedAnswer.text:
It is priced on the size of the building, how many storeys, and how much growth is on it. A single storey home in reasonable condition is a straightforward half day. A double storey with heavy lichen on the shaded elevations takes longer because the solution needs more dwell time and a second application in places.

Send a photo of the worst elevation and the suburb and you will get a fixed price back without anyone coming out.

mainEntity.name: Will it damage my paint or render?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Not at the pressures we use. Soft washing puts almost no mechanical force on the wall, which is the whole reason the method exists. What damages render and paint is a pressure washer, and the marks it leaves are permanent because it takes the finish off rather than the dirt.

Where paint is already failing, chalking or lifting we will say so before starting. Washing will not cause that, but it will show you where it already is.

mainEntity.name: Is the solution safe for plants and pets?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Garden beds are soaked before we start and rinsed again afterwards, which is what actually protects them: a saturated plant cannot take much up. Keep pets inside while we are working and until the walls and surrounds have dried.

If you have anything unusual close to the wall, a pond, a vegetable bed, an established fern or a fish tank near an open window, tell us when you book and we will work around it.

mainEntity.name: How long until the mould comes back?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Treated properly, usually three to five years on a reasonably exposed wall. A south-facing elevation under trees that never dries out will be shorter, and that is about the conditions rather than the clean.

If a wall is simply rinsed rather than treated, expect it back within a year, because the root structure was never killed. That is the difference you are paying for, and it is not visible on the day.

mainEntity.name: Do you clean the windows at the same time?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, and it is the sensible order: walls first, then glass. Washing an elevation after the windows have been done just dirties them again. Window cleaning is quoted separately but done on the same visit.

mainEntity.name: Can you clean a two storey house without scaffolding?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, on almost all residential work. Soft washing is done from the ground with extension gear because it does not rely on getting close to the wall. That is another advantage of the method: no ladders leaning on render, and no access cost on a normal two storey home.
